scope: Entire quarantine commit/restoration, inventory and projected location modules; preparation and relocation executors remain separate scopes
checks: Commit plan, prepared proof and exact source/retained inode locations are verified
Exclusive same-parent rename preserves inode and refuses owner destination
Interrupted multi-file commit and restore remain recoverable without overwriting owner bytes
Inventory exposes partial, unknown, unregistered, changed and unsafe content
Projected locations bind completed switch, staging root inode and per-file copy identities
Same-byte replacement and unknown files block forward/reverse recovery
